newsitem.title: USA: Natl City unit to buy loan offices.
newsitem.headline: Natl City unit to buy loan offices.

text.p: National City Mortgage Co said it definitively agreed to buy Commonwealth United Mortgage's loan origination business, adding more than 60 offices in areas the Ohio company currently does not serve.
National City, a subsidiary of National City Corp, said it agreed to buy the assets for an undisclosed amount from Bank United Corp of Houston, which owns Commonwealth United Mortgage.
The deal involves Commonwealth United offices but not its current mortgages, which will still be served by United Bank.

"This purchase fits National City Mortgage Co's strategic plan because it will give us market presence in nine of the 10 fastest-growing Metropolitan Statistical Areas in the United States, and adds more than 60 production offices in regions where we currently have none," said National City Mortgage Co President Leo Knight, who predicted that the extra capacity will "provide steady growth with significantly higher market coverage."
Besides the loan origination offices, National City will be acquiring four regional operations centers and four wholesale mortgage loan origination offices.
